entries.title: Draft source status: reported critical-percolation resolution, audit pending
entries.statement: DRAFT source-status record, not a verified theorem. A September 24, 2026 OpenAI primary manuscript, No percolation at criticality on quasi-transitive graphs, reports that independent Bernoulli bond percolation on every infinite connected locally finite quasi-transitive undirected graph G with p_c(G)<1 has probability zero of any infinite open cluster at p_c(G). Its reported scope includes nearest-neighbor bond percolation on Z^d for every d>=2 and hence C0023's assigned dimensions 3 through 10. The manuscript's proof and actual formal solution have not been independently audited in this record. The separate public comparator statement files contain sorry and cannot by themselves certify a proof. No original C0023 solved credit is claimed.
